title: MPL Indonesia Season 18 — Esports Match & Draft Dataset
subtitle: 72 matches, 174 games, 1740 player-game rows with drafts, hero pools and team stats
description:
MPL Indonesia (Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Professional League) Season 18, scraped from the official league site id-mpl.com.

**Contents**

- 72 completed matches and 8 scheduled playoff slots with dates, times, rounds and series scores
- 174 individual games with duration, winner, and team kills
- 1,740 player-game rows: hero, K/D/A, damage dealt, damage taken, tower damage, gold, emblem, runes, items
- 1,740 draft picks across 91 heroes, with team and side attribution
- Season aggregates: team totals, player totals, hero pick/ban/win rates, hero pools, player pools, MVP standings
- Derived analytics: hero pair synergy, hero-vs-hero matchups, head-to-head series records, weekly team form

**Sanity checks that hold**

- hero picks = hero-pool picks = player-pool picks = player-game rows = 1,740
- standings wins = losses, net game difference sums to zero
- every completed match has a detail row, every game has exactly 10 players
- no dangling player or team ids across tables

**Known gaps** (source does not publish them)

- per-game bans; only season ban totals per hero exist
- player nationality, profile pages, contract dates
- historical seasons (the site serves only the live season)
- playoff standings as rows (published as an image)
